(2026-09-06 code review fix: the exemption checks the WHOLE reply for a '?', not just the current sentence). guardReply() sees the whole reply at once and applies this correctly; gateGuards() (the streaming path) checks one sentence as it arrives and genuinely cannot see sentence 2's own '?' before sentence 1 is already spoken - guards.ts's own GuardContext.replyHasQuestion doc comment names this as a real, accepted limitation of streaming ('not something a lookahead could fix without delaying speech'), not a Fix C regression. streamingSkip documents the gap rather than silently asserting it doesn't exist.
